The Defective Detective — Album 2: Serah Investigates

Colorless Love

"Colorless love Doesn’t ask permission"

[Verse] “Miaka, calm the eastern blocks” “Miaka, soften public shock” “Miaka, shift the evening tone” “Make the unrest feel overblown”

“Miaka, tell them all is well” “Miaka, make resistance fail” “Miaka, move the numbers right” “Turn the anger down tonight”

I nod

I smile

I make the whole room breathe

Then think of one man They taught me not to see

[Pre-Chorus] Brad

Orange beside his name Yeti blood A different lane

They say the system knows his place

So why do I know his face?

[Chorus] Colorless love Doesn’t ask permission Doesn’t check a file Doesn’t need admission

Colorless love Doesn’t care who’s above If your heart can cross the border What exactly are the colors for?

Colorless love

[Verse] “Miaka, sway the morning feed” “Miaka, give them what they need” “Miaka, frame the loss as small” “Miaka, make them trust us all”

I know exactly what to say How to make the panic fade Which frequency can ease the fear Which word makes people disappear

But Brad still waits Where Orange lives

And every time I visit him I see the things this system gives

To me

And takes from him

[Pre-Chorus] He laughs Like none of this is strange Like love is simple Like the world can change

And I keep thinking

If he’s so wrong

Why do I feel right when I’m with him?

[Chorus] Colorless love Doesn’t ask permission Doesn’t check a file Doesn’t need admission

Colorless love Doesn’t care who’s above If your heart can cross the border What exactly are the colors for?

Colorless love

[Bridge] I have watched a Silver cry Watched a Yellow lose their rights Watched an Orange turned away Then wrote the words that saved the day

Saved whose day?

That question stays

Brad says, “Don’t destroy yourself for me.”

I say, “What if I’m not?”

“What if I’m finally starting to see?”

[Break] “Miaka.”

“Yes?”

“The crowd is rising again.”

“Understood.”

“Miaka, make them quiet.”

…

I can

That’s the problem

[Pre-Chorus] One command One softer phrase One little push

And rage becomes acceptance Pain becomes

“Everything’s okay”

But maybe everything Was never okay

[Chorus] Colorless love Doesn’t ask permission Doesn’t check a file Doesn’t need admission

Colorless love Doesn’t care who’s above If your heart can cross the border What exactly are the colors for?

Colorless love

[Final Chorus] Colorless love Now the lines are getting thinner Every order sounds a little Less like peace and more like winter

Colorless love Maybe Brad was never wrong Maybe Orange never measured Anything that mattered all along

Colorless love If the system calls this shame Then maybe something in the system Needs a different name

Colorless love

No Platinum No Silver No Red No Orange

Just Brad

Just me

And a question I can’t make disappear

[Outro] “Miaka, the numbers are stabilizing.”

Good

“Excellent work.”

…

Thank you

The screen goes dark

I look out at the city

Then at his message

Are you coming tonight?

I type:

Yes.

Then stop

Delete it

Type again

Always.
